responsibility: Implements LoongArch-specific C-family preprocessor builtins. It defines architecture, tuning, ABI, word-size, floating-point ABI, register-length, and data-size macros and assertions such as __loongarch__, __loongarch64, __loongarch_frlen, and _LOONGARCH_ARCH/_TUNE based on the resolved target configuration, so front ends and headers can test the active LoongArch compilation model.
